ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: It is known that the graph of the linear function $y=kx+b$ is as shown in the figure. What is the range of $y$ when $x<1$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Consider the linear function $y=kx+b$. Its graph intersects the $y$-axis at $(0, -4)$, \\
$\therefore b=-4$, and intersects the $x$-axis at $(2, 0)$, \\
$\therefore 0=2k-4$, \\
$\therefore k=2$, \\
$\therefore y=kx+b=2x-4$, \\
$\therefore x=(y+4)/2<1$, \\
$\therefore \boxed{y<-2}$.
